attempts.text:
**The window starts on a persistent four-gene stretch.** Columns 0 to 3, `hemB`, `tauD`, `tauC` and `tauB`, are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 5% of calls. The model names 94 to 98% of them, fewest at `tauD`, 94%, and hesitates most at `hemB`, 0.36 bits.

**Then a fork and variable stretch**, columns 4 to 8, in a region of plasticity in 77 to 86% of calls. The model names 69 to 96% there, fewest at column 5, 69%, and hesitates most at column 6, `yaiP`, 1.55 bits. The forks carry `yaiP` and `yaiO`; a branch at columns 5 to 8 carries an IS1-like element transposase, a PIG-L deacetylase family protein and an ABC transporter substrate-binding protein.

**A persistent stretch follows**, columns 9 to 12, `frmR` to `yaiL`, carried by 94 to 95% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 6 to 19% of calls, named 97 to 98%. Then the `mhp` genes, columns 13 to 20, variable, [[2,3-dihydroxyphenylpropionate catabolism]], in a region of plasticity in 70 to 87% of calls, named 95 to 99%. Columns 21 to 23 are spine, `lacI`, `lacZ` and `lacY`, [[lactose catabolism]], in a region of plasticity in 86 to 87% of calls, named 89 to 97%.

**Columns 37 to 52 open the graph widest.** These fork and variable columns are in a region of plasticity in 76 to 95% of calls, named 60 to 92%, fewest at column 41, 60%. A branch through columns 41 to 45 carries ABC transporter permeases and an ATP-binding cassette domain-containing protein. Columns 53 to 55, `betI`, `betB` and `betA`, are spine, in a region of plasticity in 94% of calls, named 88 to 91%.

**The window ends at `paoB`**, column 79, in 35% of chromosomes. Columns 56 to 79 are fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 83 to 94% of calls, named 75 to 91%, fewest and most hesitant at column 79, 75%, 1.27 bits. The forks carry `ykgM`, `ecpR` to `ecpE` and `ykgJ`; a branch through columns 70 to 75 carries aldo/keto reductases, a LysR family transcriptional regulator and `ycaN`. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.69 against 0.26 bits, and names fewer genes, 87% against 95%.

label: hemB
facts:
WINDOW: the hemB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hemB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,340 to 3,419 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hemB once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.58 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 11,484 calls, named 97%, 0.22 bits; shell 30,893 calls, named 88%, 0.65 bits; cloud 583 calls, named 6%, 4.00 bits. Outside an RGP 10,993 calls, named 95%, 0.26 bits; inside an RGP 31,967 calls, named 87%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 22 spine, 17 fork, 41 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.26 bits) and names fewer genes (87% against 95%); 31,967 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (yaiP) 1.55 bits, RGP 86%; column 5 ("hypothetical protein") 1.40 bits, RGP 86%; column 7 ("acetyltransferase") 1.32 bits, RGP 86%. The 64 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.67 bits on average; the other 16 columns: named 96%, 0.23 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 53-55 (spine), RGP 94%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0.2-5%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-5%. Genes: hemB, tauD, tauC, tauB. named 94-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 1 (tauD), named 94%; most hesitant at column 0 (hemB), 0.36 bits.
2. columns 4-8 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 77-86%. named 69-96% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 5, named 69%; most hesitant at column 6, 1.55 bits.
   4 variable: tauA S 90% "glycine betaine ABC transporter sub…"
   5 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 60%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 39%, "PIG-L deacetylase family protein" S 18%, "response regulator transcription factor" S 10%
   6 fork: yaiP S 76% "glycosyltransferase"; also "MASE1 domain-containing protein" S 10%
   7 variable: "acetyltransferase" S 78%
   8 fork: yaiO S 79% "YaiO family outer membrane beta-bar…"; also "ABC transporter substrate-binding prote…" S 10%
3. columns 9-12 (4 columns) spine: share 94-95%, all P, RGP 6-19%. Genes: frmR, frmA "S-(hydroxymethyl)glutathione dehydr…", fghA, yaiL "DUF2058 family protein". named 97-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 9 (frmR), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 12 (yaiL)).
4. columns 13-20 (8 columns) variable: RGP 70-87%. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 13, named 95%, 0.26 bits.
   columns 13-20, share 83-86%, all S: mhpT 83%, mhpE 86%, mhpF 86%, mhpD 86%, mhpC "2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate…" 86%, mhpB 86%, mhpA 85%, mhpR 86%
5. columns 21-23 (3 columns) spine: share 91-94%, 2 P, 1 S, RGP 86-87%. Genes: lacI, lacZ, lacY "oligosaccharide MFS transporter". named 89-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 23 (lacY), named 89%, 0.76 bits.
6. columns 24-28 (5 columns) variable: RGP 70-92%. named 94-95% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 26, named 94%; most hesitant at column 24, 0.61 bits.
   columns 24-28, share 82-85%, all S: lacA 85%, cynX 82%, cynS 83%, cynT "carbonic anhydrase CynT" 83%, cynR 83%
7. columns 29-36 (8 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 14-36%. Genes: codA, codB "cytosine permease", prpE, prpD, prpC, prpB "isocitrate lyase/phosphoenolpyruvat…", prpR, yahO "DUF1471 family periplasmic protein…". named 94-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 34 (prpB), named 94%; most hesitant at column 36 (yahO), 0.29 bits.
8. columns 37-52 (16 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 76-95%. named 60-92% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 41, named 60%; most hesitant at column 43, 0.71 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 41-45, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 21-22%, all S; the branch's families: "ABC transporter permease", "ABC transporter permease subunit", "ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…", "substrate-binding domain-containing pro…", "ASCH domain-containing protein"
   37 variable: yahN S 88% "LysE family transporter"
   38 variable: yahM S 82% "protein YahM"
   39 variable: yahL S 72%
   40 variable: yahK S 86%
   41 fork: yahJ S 84% "amidohydrolase family protein"; also ipbA S 15%
   42 fork: yahI S 84% "carbamate kinase"; also hyxR S 17%
   43 fork: yahH S 58%; also hyxA S 17%
   44 fork: yahG S 77% "YlbE family protein"; also hyxB S 16%
   45 fork: fdrA S 84%
   columns 46-52 variable, share 46-90%, all S: yahE "DUF2877 domain-containing protein" 81%, yahD "ankyrin repeat domain-containing pr…" 85%, yahC "DUF1097 domain-containing protein" 86%, yahB "LysR family transcriptional regulat…" 85%, pdeL 85%, "hypothetical protein" 46%, betT "BCCT family transporter" 90%
9. columns 53-55 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all S, RGP 94%. Genes: betI, betB, betA. named 88-91% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 54 (betB), named 88%; most hesitant at column 55 (betA), 0.62 bits.
10. columns 56-79 (24 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 83-94%. named 75-91% (mean 83%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 79, named 75%, 1.27 bits.
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 70-75, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 24-27%, all S; the branch's families: "aldo/keto reductase", "aldo/keto reductase", "LysR family transcriptional regulator", ycaN, "alpha/beta hydrolase", "hypothetical protein"
   columns 56-66 variable, share 65-88%, all S: ykgH 78%, ykgG "LUD domain-containing protein" 88%, ykgF "LutB/LldF family L-lactate oxidatio…" 88%, ykgE "(Fe-S)-binding protein" 85%, rclR 83%, rclA 80%, rclB "reactive chlorine resistance peripl…" 80%, rclC 78%, ykgA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…" 71%, fdeC 65%, ykgR "small membrane protein YkgR" 72%
   67 fork: ykgM S 71% "50S ribosomal protein L31"; also "aldo/keto reductase" S 33%
   68 variable: ykgO S 70% "type B 50S ribosomal protein L36"
   69 variable: ykgL S 45%
   70 fork: ecpR S 66%
   71 fork: ecpA S 61%
   72 fork: ecpB S 59% "fimbrial chaperone EcpB"
   73 fork: ecpC S 52%; also ecpD S 52%
   74 fork: ecpE S 55%
   75 fork: ykgJ S 54% "YkgJ family cysteine cluster protein"
   76 variable: proA P 13%
   77 fork: yagU S 38% "YagU family protein"; also proB P 11%
   78 variable: paoA S 38% "2Fe-2S iron-sulfur cluster-binding…"
   79 fork: paoB S 35%; also paoC S 26%, paoD S 21%
